D01.name: 麦穗鱼
D01.form: a slightly depressed anterior body, a small superior mouth with a nearly vertical gape, thin lips, no barbels
D01.fins: a dorsal fin with soft unbranched rays and no spines, the dorsal fin origin slightly behind the pelvic fin origin, short small pectoral and pelvic fins, a forked tail fin
D01.markings: crescent-shaped marks along the rear edge of the scales, a longitudinal band along the flank in juveniles
D01.colour: 体背部灰黑色，腹部银白色；腹膜银灰色而有小黑点；幼鱼体侧常有暗色纵带

D02.name: 白条
D02.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a slightly arched back, a small pointed head, an upward-directed mouth, no barbels, cycloid scales, a complete lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
D02.fins: a short dorsal fin with a spine, a deeply forked tail fin
D02.colour: 体背青灰色，体侧及腹部银白色

D03.name: 鲫鱼
D03.form: a deep laterally compressed body, a slightly arched back, a small head, a short blunt snout, a terminal mouth, no barbels, cycloid scales, a complete lateral line
D03.fins: a long dorsal fin with a stout serrated spine, a deeply forked tail fin
D03.colour: 体背灰黑色，体侧银灰色，腹部白色

D04.name: 泥鳅
D04.form: an elongated body with a cylindrical anterior part and a laterally compressed posterior part, a pointed head, five pairs of barbels, small degenerate eyes
D04.colour: 体背部及两侧深灰色，腹部灰白色或浅黄色

D05.name: 鳑鲏
D05.form: a small body, a small mouth, no barbels at the corners of the mouth, an incomplete lateral line, no ventral keel, a short caudal peduncle
D05.markings: a longitudinal band along the caudal peduncle
D05.colour: 体侧尾柄处有深色纵带

D06.name: 食蚊鱼
D06.form: an elongated slightly compressed body, a short broad head, a flattened anterior head, a short snout, large eyes, a wide flat interorbital space, a small superior mouth with a horizontal gape, no barbels, cycloid scales on head and body, no lateral line, a broad long flattened caudal peduncle
D06.fins: small pectoral and pelvic fins, the pelvic fins set very close to the anal fin, a large dorsal fin, a large rounded tail fin, the third to fifth anal fin rays elongated into a rod-shaped gonopodium in males

D07.name: 塘鳢
D07.form: an elongated stout body, a large broad flat head, a wide short snout, medium-sized scales, no lateral line
D07.markings: 3 to 4 irregular vertical bands crossing the flanks, markings on the head and underside, banded fins
D07.colour: 体色黑褐，各鳍有淡黄色和黑色相间的条纹

D09.name: 黄颡鱼
D09.form: a large flat head, a short snout, a large inferior mouth, four pairs of barbels, naked skin with no scales, a complete lateral line
D09.markings: three interrupted bands along the flanks
D09.colour: 体背部黑褐色，体侧黄色，腹部淡黄色，各鳍灰黑色

D10.name: 小鲤鱼
D10.form: a deep laterally compressed body, a slightly arched back, a moderate-sized head, a short blunt snout, a terminal mouth, two pairs of barbels, cycloid scales, a complete lateral line
D10.fins: a long dorsal fin with a stout serrated spine, a deeply forked tail fin
D10.colour: 体背灰黑或黄褐色，体侧金黄色，腹部白色
